versos.grego: Εἰ οὖν συνηγέρθητε τῷ Χριστῷ, τὰ ἄνω ζητεῖτε, οὗ ὁ Χριστός ἐστιν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ Θεοῦ καθήμενος·

controles.web: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
controles.kjv: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
controles.livre: Portanto, se fostes ressuscitados com Cristo, buscai as coisas de cima, onde Cristo está sentado à direita de Deus.

versos.grego: τὰ ἄνω φρονεῖτε, μὴ τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

controles.web: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
controles.kjv: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
controles.livre: Pensai nas coisas de cima, não nas que estão na terra.

versos.grego: ἀπεθάνετε γάρ, καὶ ἡ ζωὴ ὑμῶν κέκρυπται σὺν τῷ Χριστῷ ἐν τῷ Θεῷ·

controles.web: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
controles.kjv: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
controles.livre: Pois já morrestes, e a vossa vida está escondida com Cristo em Deus.

versos.grego: ὅταν ὁ Χριστὸς φανερωθῇ, ἡ ζωὴ ἡμῶν, τότε καὶ ὑμεῖς σὺν αὐτῷ φανερωθήσεσθε ἐν δόξῃ.

controles.web: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.
controles.kjv: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.
controles.livre: Quando Cristo, que é a nossa vida, se manifestar, então também vós vos manifestareis com ele em glória.

versos.grego: Νεκρώσατε οὖν τὰ μέλη τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, πορνείαν, ἀκαθαρσίαν, πάθος, ἐπιθυμίαν κακήν, καὶ τὴν πλεονεξίαν ἥτις ἐστὶν εἰδωλολατρεία,

controles.web: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry;
controles.kjv: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:
controles.livre: Portanto, mortificai as partes carnais que há em vós que são terrenas; são elas : o pecado sexual, a impureza, a paixão depravada, o desejo maligno, e a ganância, que é idolatria.

versos.grego: δι’ ἃ ἔρχεται ἡ ὀργὴ τοῦ Θεοῦ·

controles.web: for which things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
controles.kjv: For which things’ sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:
controles.livre: Por causa delas que a ira de Deus vem.

versos.grego: ἐν οἷς καὶ ὑμεῖς περιεπατήσατέ ποτε, ὅτε ἐζῆτε ἐν τούτοις·

controles.web: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them;
controles.kjv: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.
controles.livre: Nessas coisas também vós andastes antes, quando vivíeis nelas.

versos.grego: νυνὶ δὲ ἀπόθεσθε καὶ ὑμεῖς τὰ πάντα, ὀργήν, θυμόν, κακίαν, βλασφημίαν, αἰσχρολογίαν ἐκ τοῦ στόματος ὑμῶν·

controles.web: but now you also put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.
controles.kjv: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
controles.livre: Mas agora, abandonai, vós também, todas estas coisas : a ira, a fúria, a malícia, a maledicência, e as palavras vergonhosas da vossa boca.

versos.grego: μὴ ψεύδεσθε εἰς ἀλλήλους, ἀπεκδυσάμενοι τὸν παλαιὸν ἄνθρωπον σὺν ταῖς πράξεσιν αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,
controles.kjv: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;
controles.livre: Não mintais uns aos outros, pois já vos despistes do velho ser humano com os seus costumes,

versos.grego: καὶ ἐνδυσάμενοι τὸν νέον τὸν ἀνακαινούμενον εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν κατ’ εἰκόνα τοῦ κτίσαντος αὐτόν,

controles.web: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,
controles.kjv: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:
controles.livre: e vos revestistes do novo, que se renova em conhecimento, conforme a imagem daquele que o criou.

versos.grego: ὅπου οὐκ ἔνι Ἕλλην καὶ Ἰουδαῖος, περιτομὴ καὶ ἀκροβυστία, βάρβαρος, Σκύθης, δοῦλος, ἐλεύθερος, ἀλλὰ πάντα καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν Χριστός.

controles.web: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, freeman; but Christ is all, and in all.
controles.kjv: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.
controles.livre: Nisso não há grego, nem judeu, nem circunciso, nem incircunciso, bárbaro, cita, escravo, nem livre; mas Cristo é tudo, e em todos.

versos.grego: Ἐνδύσασθε οὖν, ὡς ἐκλεκτοὶ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἅγιοι καὶ ἠγαπημένοι, σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ, χρηστότητα, ταπεινοφροσύνην, πραΰτητα, μακροθυμίαν,

controles.web: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;
controles.kjv: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
controles.livre: Por isso, como escolhidos de Deus, santos e amados, revesti-vos de sentimentos de misericórdia, bondade, humildade, mansidão, e paciência.

versos.grego: ἀνεχόμενοι ἀλλήλων καὶ χαριζόμενοι ἑαυτοῖς, ἐάν τις πρός τινα ἔχῃ μομφήν· καθὼς καὶ ὁ Κύριος ἐχαρίσατο ὑμῖν οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς·

controles.web: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
controles.kjv: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
controles.livre: Suportai-vos uns aos outros, e perdoai-vos uns aos outros, se alguém tiver queixa contra outro. Como o Senhor vos perdoou, assim também fazei .

versos.grego: ἐπὶ πᾶσιν δὲ τούτοις τὴν ἀγάπην, ὅ ἐστιν σύνδεσμος τῆς τελειότητος.

controles.web: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
controles.kjv: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
controles.livre: E acima de tudo isto, revesti-vos do amor, que é o vínculo da perfeição.

versos.grego: καὶ ἡ εἰρήνη τοῦ Χριστοῦ βραβευέτω ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν, εἰς ἣν καὶ ἐκλήθητε ἐν ἑνὶ σώματι· καὶ εὐχάριστοι γίνεσθε.

controles.web: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful.
controles.kjv: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
controles.livre: E a paz de Cristo, para a qual também fostes chamados em um só corpo, governe em vossos corações, e sede gratos.

versos.grego: ὁ λόγος τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐνοικείτω ἐν ὑμῖν πλουσίως, ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ· διδάσκοντες καὶ νουθετοῦντες ἑαυτοὺς, ψαλμοῖς ὕμνοις ᾠδαῖς πνευματικαῖς ἐν τῇ χάριτι ᾄδοντες ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν τῷ Θεῷ·

controles.web: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
controles.kjv: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
controles.livre: A palavra de Cristo habite abundantemente em vós com toda sabedoria, ensinando-vos e advertindo-vos uns aos outros; e cantai a Deus com salmos, hinos, e cânticos espirituais, com graça no vosso coração.

versos.grego: καὶ πᾶν ὅ τι ἐὰν ποιῆτε ἐν λόγῳ ἢ ἐν ἔργῳ, πάντα ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ, εὐχαριστοῦντες τῷ Θεῷ Πατρὶ δι’ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.
controles.kjv: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
controles.livre: E tudo quanto fizerdes, por palavras ou por obras, fazei tudo no nome do Senhor Jesus, dando por meio dele graças ao Deus e Pai.

versos.grego: Αἱ γυναῖκες, ὑποτάσσεσθε τοῖς ἀνδράσιν, ὡς ἀνῆκεν ἐν Κυρίῳ.

controles.web: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
controles.kjv: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.
controles.livre: Mulheres, sede submissas aos vossos maridos, como convém no Senhor.

versos.grego: Οἱ ἄνδρες, ἀγαπᾶτε τὰς γυναῖκας καὶ μὴ πικραίνεσθε πρὸς αὐτάς.

controles.web: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.
controles.kjv: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
controles.livre: Maridos, amai às esposas, e não as trateis amargamente.

versos.grego: Τὰ τέκνα, ὑπακούετε τοῖς γονεῦσιν κατὰ πάντα, τοῦτο γὰρ εὐάρεστόν ἐστιν ἐν Κυρίῳ.

controles.web: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.
controles.kjv: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
controles.livre: Filhos, obedecei em tudo aos pais, porque isso é agradável ao Senhor.

versos.grego: Οἱ πατέρες, μὴ ἐρεθίζετε τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν, ἵνα μὴ ἀθυμῶσιν.

controles.web: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.
controles.kjv: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.
controles.livre: Pais, não provoqueis aos vossos filhos, para que não percam o ânimo.

versos.grego: Οἱ δοῦλοι, ὑπακούετε κατὰ πάντα τοῖς κατὰ σάρκα κυρίοις, μὴ ἐν ὀφθαλμοδουλίαις, ὡς ἀνθρωπάρεσκοι, ἀλλ’ ἐν ἁπλότητι καρδίας φοβούμενοι τὸν Κύριον.

controles.web: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.
controles.kjv: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:
controles.livre: Escravos, obedecei em tudo aos vossos senhores segundo a carne, não servindo apenas quando observados, como que para satisfazer às pessoas, mas sim, com sinceridade de coração, temendo ao Senhor.

versos.grego: ὃ ἐὰν ποιῆτε, ἐκ ψυχῆς ἐργάζεσθε ὡς τῷ Κυρίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἀνθρώποις,

controles.web: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men,
controles.kjv: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
controles.livre: Tudo quanto fizerdes, fazei de coração, como que para o Senhor, e não para as pessoas.

versos.grego: εἰδότες ὅτι ἀπὸ Κυρίου ἀπολήμψεσθε τὴν ἀνταπόδοσιν τῆς κληρονομίας. τῷ Κυρίῳ Χριστῷ δουλεύετε·

controles.web: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
controles.kjv: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.
controles.livre: Pois sabeis que recebereis do Senhor a recompensa da herança;servi ao Senhor Cristo.

versos.grego: ὁ γὰρ ἀδικῶν κομίσεται ὃ ἠδίκησεν, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν προσωπολημψία.

controles.web: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
controles.kjv: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
controles.livre: Pois aquele que fizer injustiça receberá conforme a injustiça que cometer; e não há acepção de pessoas.
